name: Storm Breath (Elnoyle)
doc: Storm Breath (Elnoyle's enemy attack; module 213 is Storm Breath 11's code): a breath stream from the caster's mouth sweeping its targets in turn, layouts at the mouth, mist and rings blown along it, hit sparks on the targets, sparks and debris off the stream, a start sound. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag213_storm_breath.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Timing
parts.doc: The breath's sound and its end (draws nothing)

parts.title: Stream
parts.doc: The breath stream from the mouth sweeping the targets, its angles; the layouts at the mouth

parts.title: Sparks
parts.doc: Hit sparks on the current target, sparks and debris off the stream

parts.title: Mist and rings
parts.doc: Mist blown out of the mouth, rings along the stream

groups.label: Hits

groups.label: Debris
groups.doc: Within the sparks' first Ticks: chance Chance / 32768, thrown up by Speed + (rand & Spread)

groups.label: Mist
groups.doc: Two a tick: slow from From for Ticks, then fast from From 2 for Ticks 2

groups.label: Rings
groups.doc: From tick From for Ticks, one every Every ticks
